data.name: SuperTag
data.detailed_description:
SuperTag is a first-person parkour game built around speed, movement control, and direct competition. Every action matters: momentum, angles, and decision-making define whether you escape or get caught.

The game takes place in a semi-futuristic setting where traditional parkour evolved into a structured competitive sport. Tag is no longer a playground activity — it became an organized discipline centered on pursuit, mind games, and optimal movement routes. This sport is known as SuperTag.

Two core modes are available:

Tag (1v1 Duel)
Face another player in a direct confrontation. One chases, the other escapes. The hunter must predict movement and cut routes, while the runner relies on mastery of traversal mechanics to survive as long as possible.

Climb The Tower (Time Attack)
A race against the clock. Players attempt to achieve the best time on dedicated maps and compete on leaderboards. Every jump, wallrun and landing must be optimized to gain milliseconds and beat other players’ records.

SuperTag focuses on readable level design, mechanical skill, and replayability through mastery rather than randomness. Movement is the core gameplay — the better you move, the better you perform.

data.short_description: A first-person competitive parkour game where high velocity parkour becomes a sport. Chase your opponent in Strategic Draft 1v1 duels or perfect your routes in Climb The Tower time-attack maps to set the fastest record.
